title: E-QTM-0135: a relational record: the reflection through the frame direction, the one covariant three-body meeting...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0135 in the quantum arena: a relational record: the reflection through the frame direction, the one covariant three-body meeting that is not a permutation, measures a role exactly along the axis of a love-fear apparatus opened on one line, on every state the knit reaches; the apparatus is a knot and the triple is not, and the meeting keeps loves, fears and the color content.
